records.source: You've done a good job with the place.#$b#It seems you've tried your best... that's all I can ask for. I'm proud of you.
records.translation: Mahusay ang ginawa mo sa lugar na ito.#$b#Mukhang ginawa mo ang lahat ng makakaya mo... iyon lang ang mahihiling ko. Ipinagmamalaki kita.

records.source: You've done well, my boy.^You've done well, my dear.#$b#%farm Farm has never looked better. It's an honor to the family name.#$b#Grandpa is pleased.
records.translation: Napakahusay ng ginawa mo, anak ko.^Napakahusay ng ginawa mo, mahal ko.#$b#Hindi kailanman naging ganito kaganda ang %farm Farm. Nagbibigay ito ng malaking karangalan sa pangalan ng pamilya.#$b#Natutuwa si Lolo.
records.englishResidueReason: The engine substitution requires the literal compound '%farm Farm'; changing Farm breaks the generated farm name.

records.source: I'm so proud of you, my boy!^I'm so proud of you, my dear!#$b#You're a better farmer than I ever was, and you've brought great honor to the family name.#$b#I can feel it now... My spirit is finally put to rest. Bless you.
records.translation: Ipinagmamalaki kita, anak ko!^Ipinagmamalaki kita, mahal ko!#$b#Mas mahusay kang magsasaka kaysa sa akin noon, at nagdala ka ng malaking karangalan sa pangalan ng pamilya.#$b#Nararamdaman ko na... Sa wakas, mapayapa na ang aking espiritu. Pagpalain ka.

records.source: Um, excuse me.#$b#I have a gift for you. I found it last summer when I was playing at the beach. I hope you like it.$h
records.translation: Um, paumanhin po.#$b#May regalo ako sa iyo. Natagpuan ko ito noong nakaraang tag-init habang naglalaro ako sa Dalampasigan. Sana magustuhan mo.$h

records.source: I'm glad you moved here, farmer @!$h
records.translation: Natutuwa akong lumipat ka rito, magsasakang @!$h

records.source: Hey, @. I'm your secret gift-giver this year.#$b#Here, open it.$h
records.translation: Hoy, @. Ako ang lihim mong tagapagbigay ng regalo ngayong taon.#$b#Heto, buksan mo.$h

records.source: It's not much, but I hope you like it.$h
records.translation: Hindi ito kalakihan, pero sana magustuhan mo.$h

records.source: Hi. So, I'm your secret gift-giver this year.#$b#Well? Open it!
records.translation: Kumusta. Ako pala ang lihim mong tagapagbigay ng regalo ngayong taon.#$b#O? Buksan mo na!

records.source: It's nothing fancy, but it's the best I could afford.
records.translation: Hindi ito marangya, pero ito ang pinakamagandang nakayanan ko.

records.source: Your grange display has been judged. Return to Mayor Lewis for the result!
records.translation: Nasuri na ng mga hurado ang Tanghalang Bukid mo. Bumalik kay Alkalde Lewis para sa resulta!

records.source: Of course I'll dance with you!$h
records.translation: Siyempre, sasayaw ako kasama mo!$h

records.source: You want to be my partner for the flower dance?#$b#Okay. I look forward to it.$h
records.translation: Gusto mo akong maging kapareha sa Sayaw ng mga Bulaklak?#$b#Sige. Sabik na ako.$h
